utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, all. Friday the 27th. Everyone on? And nobody mention the football last night, please. I've suffered enough.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: I'm more concerned about the heating in the portakabin. It's either tropical or you can see your breath. Just having a moan, before that goes on your list.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: You got tropical? Luxury. We only seem to get the other setting.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Sorry, yeah, I'm here. Traffic on the ring road was ridiculous. Three lanes of people looking at absolutely nothing.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, lovely. Let's start with what's finished, then the actual jobs.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: I signed off the inspection on the outfeed conveyor on Tuesday. That's closed, not something we need to carry over.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep, got that. It was still showing on the old view, that's all.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And I tested the Injection Moulding Line 3 yesterday and it's all fine now. Finished from my side.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Same sort of thing here: tested the line 1 TCU yesterday and it's all fine now. Nothing outstanding on that test.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Good. Actual closed items. We do occasionally have those, then.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Also, the shutdown on the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve is cancelled now, production need it running. So that shutdown's off, not waiting for me to do it today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. Cancelled, not deferred on today's list.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, two observations. Heard a slight rattle from the palletiser, nothing to action yet.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Right, just an observation. Not turning that into a job.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: And noticed the line 2 robot was running a bit warm on nights but it settled down. The warmth isn't an outstanding issue.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. There's still the separate jam and sensor check on the line 2 robot, though. That's not the temperature observation.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll clear the jam and check the sensors on the line 2 robot by Thursday. That's fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—yeah, separate thing. I didn't want the warm-running comment getting muddled up with the jam.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Agreed. Jamie, you've got the line 2 robot, by Thursday, fairly important.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, that's mine. Clear the jam and check the sensors.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you grease and check the bearings on the line 3 barrel today? Not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: I can't take that today, sorry. And separately, I still can't get to the fire alarm panel until production gives us a window. That's blocked; I'm not promising anything on that either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, the fire alarm panel stays blocked. PR, can you take the line 3 barrel bearings instead of Aisha? Still today, not an emergency but don't let it slip.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll grease and check the bearings on the line 3 barrel today. I can take that one.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Cheers. Doesn't need everyone dropping everything, just don't let it disappear into next week.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: What I can commit to: I'll do the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the air dryer on the 3rd. That's holding production up so it needs doing first.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: First for that slot on the 3rd, yeah? Not saying the sign-off's happening today.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Exactly. On the 3rd, and it needs doing first because it's holding production up.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Aisha owns the lock-out tag-out sign-off on the air dryer. On the 3rd, first because of the production hold.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Jamie, can you order spare parts for the stretch wrapper at half two? Normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, I'll order spare parts for the stretch wrapper at half two.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks. Normal priority, so I'm not asking for a panic order.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Understood. Half two, normal priority. No dramatic phone voice required.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: While we're on purchasing, Jamie, can you chase the purchase order for the line 3 barrel next Tuesday? Low priority.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Not that one, sorry. I haven't got the approval history in front of me, and I can't take the chase on.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. PR, can I hand that to you instead—chase the purchase order for the line 3 barrel next Tuesday, low priority?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yes, I'll chase the purchase order for the line 3 barrel next Tuesday. Low priority, separate from today's bearings.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: PR, could you also swap the filter on the line one HPU by Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: No, sorry, I can't fit that one in as well. Bearings and the purchase order, yes; the filter, no.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Fair enough. Marcus, can you take over the filter swap on the line one HPU, by Wednesday?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll swap the filter on the line one HPU by Wednesday. That's mine rather than PR's.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: And I'll check the guarding on the Injection Moulding Line 1 by Wednesday.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's Callum Reid taking the guarding check on the Injection Moulding Line 1, by Wednesday, yeah? Your audio clipped at the start.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Yep, me. I'll check the guarding, by Wednesday. Teams picked a good moment there.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Marcus, can you write up the near miss at the Stretch Wrapper by the end of the week? It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: I can't take the write-up, sorry. I wasn't there for the incident, only heard about it afterwards.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Jamie Brennan, can you take that instead? Write up the near miss at the Stretch Wrapper by the end of the week. It matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yeah, I was there. I'll write up the near miss at the Stretch Wrapper by the end of the week. Understood, it matters but it's not urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Right. That's the write-up we're agreeing, not a fresh incident response.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. And we are on Friday, so by the end of the week still stands. Not urgent doesn't mean push it into next week.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Yep, understood. The write-up's with me, by the end of the week.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Aisha, can you organise the toolbox talk for the team? Fairly important, that one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll organise the toolbox talk for the team.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Agreed on fairly important. Easy for that sort of thing to get lost among the plant jobs.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Aisha. No date or time agreed for that here; just keeping the importance clear.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Yep, mine to organise, fairly important. Got it.

utterances.speaker: Callum Reid
utterances.text: Just so we're not leaving with two versions: the outfeed conveyor inspection is already signed off. I'm not carrying that again.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And the Injection Moulding Line 3 test is done. Nothing new out of that.

utterances.speaker: Priya Raman
utterances.text: Yep. line 1 TCU test done as well, and the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve shutdown stays cancelled.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Fire alarm panel still blocked until production gives us a window. No commitment against that today.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Understood. And neither the palletiser rattle nor the settled temperature on the line 2 robot is a new action. That's everything agreed, then.

utterances.speaker: Jamie Brennan
utterances.text: Good. This meeting moved quicker than the ring road, anyway.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Low bar. I'm ending the call before the portakabin switches back to Arctic.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, cheers, everyone.
